Hymn 298: Home Can Be a Heaven on Earth
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: D Major
Composer: W. Herbert Klopfer
Lyricist/Text Author: Caroline Eyring Miner
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 298 titled "Home Can Be a Heaven on Earth" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in D Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by W. Herbert Klopfer and the lyrics were written by Caroline Eyring Miner.
This hymn is categorized under: Special Topics.
